groups.activity: claim the weekly 'Gifts of the Lotus - Stolen!' alert
groups.mode: public matchmaking if the mission is awkward solo

rows.label: Dex Dakra alert
rows.note: check the in-game Anniversary tab; the week shifts every year

conditions: The event runs roughly mid-March through early May; missing the week means waiting about a year for the next Anniversary.
There is no blueprint, drop table or vendor. The alert is the only source and the weapon is untradeable.
When it was a Defense alert, it ran a full 10 waves rather than the shorter count most Defense missions got.
bonuses: Claim it every year even if you already own it - each claim gives a free weapon slot, and the weapon arrives with an Orokin Catalyst pre-installed.
If the alert node's planet isn't unlocked, a clan mate or public squad can host it for you.

disclosures.title: 2026 schedule (Reddit-sourced, not on the wiki)
disclosures.body: Dex Sybaris Mar 20-27, Dex Dakra Apr 3-10, Dex Nikana Apr 17-24, Dex Furis May 1-8. The order and weeks shift year to year, so confirm against the in-game Anniversary tab when the 2027 event starts.

disclosures.title: can't find it after the alert
disclosures.body: Open the Lotus inbox message, then search "Dex" in the Arsenal; it arrives at rank 0 and gets lost in a long list.
